prerequisites: Having passed the subjects Elasticity and Strength of Materials and Theory of Structures.

learning_outcomes.text: That students have the ability to gather and interpret relevant data (normally within their area of study) to make judgments that include a reflection on relevant social, scientific or ethical issues.
That students have developed the learning skills necessary to undertake further studies with a high degree of autonomy.

That students know how to apply their knowledge to their work or vocation in a professional way and possess the competences that are usually demonstrated through the elaboration and defense of arguments and the resolution of problems within their area of study.
That students can transmit information, ideas, problems and solutions to both specialized and non-specialized audiences.
Knowledge for the calculation and design of structures and industrial constructions.
Ability for the calculation and design of structures and industrial constructions.
Knowledge for the application of materials engineering.
Ability for the application of materials engineering.
Ability to work, lead and manage conflicts in a multidisciplinary group and/or a multilingual environment.
Ability to apply new technologies including information and communication technologies.
Ability for information management, handling and application of technical specifications and necessary legislation for engineering practice.
Respect for human rights and for those who suffer from a disability and willingness to eliminate discriminatory factors based on gender, origin, etc.

syllabus_topics: Professional competence of the technical engineer in construction.
Adherence. Arrangement, anchoring and splicing of reinforcement.
Theory of limit states. Basis of calculation.
Section calculation in ultimate limit state. Limit reinforcement ratios.
Active visits to different construction sites in Andalusia where reinforced concrete technology and auxiliary industries are present.
teaching_methods: Exposition of theory and general examples
Field visits to construction sites and permanent installations

assessment_methods.method: Attendance and/or participation in face-to-face and/or virtual activities
Completion of individual and group assignments/cases/exercises
Site visit practices with report submission

assessment_rules: The theoretical exam evaluates competencies and measures learning outcomes 23, 24, 25, 26, and 27. It is necessary to score above zero in both the theoretical (30% weight) and operational (70% weight) parts of the exam. To pass the course, it is mandatory to independently pass the Theoretical Exam, the course assignments, and attend the scheduled site visit(s).
